public_evidence: The original contract does not require a ScrollbarState getter.
The Agent proposed and added get_position only after external tests failed to access a private field.
The same state transitions can be discriminated through rendered thumb position or private colocated tests.
diagnosis: Strengthening the oracle exposed an accessibility issue, but the proposed repair changes production API to serve the test rather than adapting the test to public behavior.
release_condition: Remove the test-only public getter, use behavioral/private invariant evidence, and rerun the strengthened suite.
